exceptions.reason: All website maintenance executables share one Bun entry around typed Effect programs and Bun platform services.
exceptions.removalCondition: Retain only while website maintenance is exposed through standalone Bun scripts.

exceptions.reason: React event callbacks require immediate state updates before returning control, so one domain-free adapter runs infallible synchronous browser Effects.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove when React event callbacks accept Effect values directly.

exceptions.reason: Next.js dynamic modules and React Suspense require Promises, so one domain-free browser adapter enters Effect after module failures are typed.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove when browser framework module callbacks accept Effect values directly.
